ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 40% high-intensity (white/light-grey) pixels and 60% low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Stochastic distribution of high-intensity pixel clusters (mottling). Left lobe features a high density of circular rosette geometries. Right lobe exhibits elongated linear streaks and larger contiguous white patches near the distal tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression; interior angle approximately 42 degrees; the vertex is partially occluded by spray and water turbulence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations. The right distal edge displays prominent nodular protrusions (5-12 pixel amplitude). The left trailing edge shows more uniform, lower-amplitude jaggedness.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature on leading edges; trailing edges follow a generally horizontal trajectory with significant localized deviations due to edge erosion.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense detection of circular, high-contrast ring-shaped artifacts (8-15 pixel diameter) with dark centers, primarily concentrated on the medial and proximal regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Prominent intersecting linear high-intensity marks on the lower right-central fluke surface, forming a clear inverted-V or lambda-shaped geometry.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tattering and probable historical tissue loss along the trailing edge of the left lobe; ubiquitous circular and linear depigmentation marks across the entire visible surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive 'lambda' (Λ) shaped linear scar pattern located near the fluke center-right intersection.
